pillars.title: One kit, not a pile of subscriptions.
pillars.subtitle: Three things Chalyb does for you so you never have to assemble anything yourself.

1.title: AI tools included, not sold separately
1.body: ChalyClip for clips, ChalyCrypto for signals, ChalyOBS for your broadcast and more. Each is an inner tool of the kit: you come in for one and find the others already in your plan.

bullets.1: ChalyClip turns your streams into vertical clips ready to post
bullets.2: ChalyCrypto delivers backtested crypto signals and alerts
bullets.3: Every new tool joins the kit at no extra cost

2.title: Explore free. Go live when it convinces you
2.body: On Free you explore the ready tools in simulation. Pro puts one live, your choice; VIP opens the whole kit. Each tool's status reads the same here and inside the app.

bullets.1: Simulation with test data, never touching your accounts
bullets.2: Pro: one live tool of your choice · VIP: the whole kit
bullets.3: Switch tools or cancel any time, no lock-in

3.title: One meter, one charge
3.body: AI tokens included in every plan, per-tool usage history and a single monthly charge through Mercado Pago. No per-tool surprises.

bullets.1: Monthly AI tokens included; top-ups never expire
bullets.2: Per-tool usage history inside the app
bullets.3: Pay with Mercado Pago, cancel any time

welcome.title: Welcome to Chalyb
welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.body: Navigate everything from here, grouped into Your account, Platform and Settings. Switch sections in one click.

engines.title: Your kit
engines.body: Under “My engines” you see every tool in the kit (ChalyClip, ChalyCrypto and more) with its real status: “Ready” opens today, “Live” runs on your plan, “Coming soon” is still being built.

tokens.title: Your token balance
tokens.body: Under “Usage” you check how many AI tokens you have left this month and your consumption. Out of tokens? Top up or upgrade.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Under “Subscription” you compare Free, Pro and VIP and switch plans. “Billing” has your payments and receipts.

account.title: Your info
account.body: Under “Profile & security” you update your details, your password and your language.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: “Messages” is a direct line to the Chalyb team, and “Help” has guides and support. We've got you.

partners.metaDescription: You have the idea, we build it. Propose a tool for the Chalyb kit and share the revenue it generates.
partners.eyebrow: Partner program · secondary to the kit
partners.title: You have the idea, we build it.
partners.lead: See an AI tool missing from the kit? Tell us the idea. If it fits, the Chalyb team builds it, runs it and adds it to the kit; you receive a share of what it generates.

1.title: You propose
1.body: Describe the problem, who it is for and what the result looks like. No code needed.

2.title: We build
2.body: If it fits the kit, the Chalyb team builds and runs it on the same infrastructure as the rest.

3.title: We share
3.body: The tool joins the kit for every subscriber and you receive a share of its revenue, tracked in your account.

partners.formLead: This form goes straight to the team. We reply within 24 business hours. There is no partner dashboard or online contract yet: the conversation starts here.
partners.honest: The program is at an early stage: the share and terms are agreed case by case. We promise neither approval nor dates.
partners.backKit: The kit comes first: if you don't have an account yet, start free and get to know the tools.
